pullBubble.title: Pocket Convene
pullBubble.description: A small floating bubble you can drag anywhere on your screen — tap it to roll a ×1 or ×10 pull and watch the result animation, without opening the app or placing a widget. Requires a one-time "draw over other apps" permission grant. Drag the bubble onto the ✕ that appears while dragging it to turn it off.
pullBubble.permissionNeeded: Grant "draw over other apps" in the screen that just opened — the bubble turns on by itself once you come back.
pullBubble.permissionGranted: Permission granted — Pocket Convene is on.

about.title: About
about.madeWithSuffix: Made with ♡ for the WuWa community.
about.disclaimerBody1: Whispering Wishes is an unofficial fan-made tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with Kuro Games, Kuro Technology (HK) Co., Limited, or any of their subsidiaries.
about.disclaimerBody2: Wuthering Waves, all game content, characters, names, and related media are trademarks and copyrights of Kuro Games © 2024–{{year}}.
about.disclaimerBody3: Game data, artwork, and other assets are sourced from community resources, fan artists, and third-party trackers. While we strive for accuracy, some information may be outdated, unverified, or incorrect — always cross-check anything important in-game.
about.privacyLocalBody: Convene history, calculator settings, team builds, planner notes, and visual preferences are stored locally in your browser (localStorage). This data never leaves your device unless you explicitly use Cloud Backup or the Leaderboard.
about.privacyOnlineGoogle: Google Sign-In — If you sign in, we receive your display name, profile picture, and a unique ID. We do not store your email.
about.privacyOnlineBackup: Cloud Backup — Your Convene history is stored in Firebase under your Google user ID. Only you can read or write your own backup.
about.privacyOnlineLeaderboard: Leaderboard — Opt-in. Your hashed user ID (not your real game UID), average pity, pull count, 50/50 stats, and owned 5★ items are displayed publicly.
about.privacyOnlineActive: Active users — An anonymous heartbeat (timestamp only) is sent every 60 seconds. It expires automatically after 2 minutes.
about.privacyPermissionsCamera: Camera — requested only when you use the Convene URL scanner to photograph your screen. The image is processed for OCR and is not stored.
about.privacyPermissionsOther: Display over other apps — used only for the Convene pull animation overlay. No other device permissions (microphone, location, etc.) are used.
about.privacyThirdPartyGoogle: Google Identity Services — Sign-In authentication. Google's privacy policy applies.
about.privacyThirdPartyFirebase: Firebase (Google) — Cloud storage for backups, leaderboard, and presence.
about.privacyThirdPartyWuwa: Wuthering Waves API — Proxied to fetch your Convene history. We do not log requests.
about.privacyTrackingBody: This app does not use analytics, advertising trackers, cookies, or fingerprinting. No personal data is sold or shared with third parties.
about.privacyDeleteAll: All data (local + cloud) — Use the "Reset All Data" button below. This also deletes your public leaderboard entry, and if you are signed in with Google, your cloud backup — then signs you out.
about.privacyDeleteLocal: Local data only — Clear your browser's site data for this domain.
about.privacyDeleteLeaderboard: Leaderboard removal — Automatically deleted by "Reset All Data" above. If that isn't possible for you, contact {{email}} with your leaderboard ID instead.
about.termsIntro: By using Whispering Wishes you agree to the following:
about.termsPersonalUse: Personal use only — This tool is for personal, non-commercial use to manage your own game data.
about.termsNoAbuse: No abuse — Do not use the API proxy, OCR, or cloud features for automated scraping, mass requests, or anything unrelated to your personal game data.
about.termsResponsibility: Your responsibility — You are responsible for your Google account and game credentials. We are not liable for data loss or unauthorized access.
about.termsLeaderboard: Leaderboard — By submitting, you consent to your pseudonymous stats being displayed publicly. Offensive usernames may be removed.
about.termsWarranty: No warranty — Provided "as is". We do not guarantee uptime, accuracy, or availability. Features may change or be removed.
about.termsUnofficial: Unofficial — We are not responsible for any consequences to your game account from using third-party tools.
about.termsAge: Age — You must be at least 13 years old to use Google Sign-In or the leaderboard.
about.termsOutro: We may restrict access to users who violate these terms.
